message:
So `chk_udata.size = oh->chunk[idx].size`. The chunk size comes from the file. For chunk 0, `oh->chunk[0].size = chunk_size + H5O_SIZEOF_HDR(oh)`. Let me look at how `chunk_size` is decoded from the object header prefix:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/hdf5 && grep -n "chunk_size" src/H5Ocache.c | head -20</｜｜DSML｜｜>
